If I know anything, I shall inform you and if I do not, I shall tell you that I know nothing about it and you may ask someone who does.' I then asked, 'Who are the two women that Allaah speaks about who acted together against Rasulullaah ﷺ?' 'They were Aa'isha (RA) and Hafsah (RA),' Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied. The Awe Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Musayyib had for Hadhrat Sa'd bin Abi Waqqaas (RA)

Hadhrat Sa'eed bin Musayyib says, "I once said to Hadhrat Sa'd bin Maalik (Abi Waqqaas) (RA), 'I wish to pose certain questions to you, but I stand in too much awe of you.' 'Dear son of my brother,' he said, 'do not stand in awe of me. If you feel that I know anything, feel free to ask me.' I then asked, 'What was it that Rasulullaah ﷺ said to Hadhrat Ali (RA) when he appointed him as his deputy during the expedition to Tabook?' Hadhrat Sa'd (RA) replied, 'Rasulullaah ﷺ said, 'O Ali! Does it not please you to know that your status with me is like that of Haaroon (AS) with Moosa (AS).'" [^2]
Hadhrat Jubayr bin Mut'im (RA) Responds to a Question by saying, "I have no knowledge on the subject"

blocks.narrator: Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Abdullaah bin Mowhab
blocks.text: Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Abdullaah bin Mowhab narrates that Hadhrat Jubayr bin Mut'im (RA) was passing through an oasis when the people questioned him about a matter of inheritance. Hadhrat Jubayr (RA) responded by saying, "I have no knowledge on the subject. You may however send someone with me and I will enquire about it on your behalf." The people sent someone with him and Hadhrat Jubayr (RA) posed the question to Hadhrat Umar (RA). Hadhrat Umar (RA) remarked, "Whoever wishes to be an Aalim with keen understanding should do as Jubayr bin Mut'im (RA) has done. When asked about something he did not know, he said, 'Allaah knows best.'" [^3]
The Conduct of Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) in his Teaching

Hadhrat Mujaahid reports that when Hadhrat Abdullaah bin Umar (RA) was once questioned about an aspect of children's inheritance, he replied, "I do not know." "What prevents you from replying?" someone asked. His reply was, "When Abdullaah bin Umar was asked about something he did not know, he replied by saying, 'I do not know.'" [^4]
Ibn Abdul Birr in his Jaami (Vol.1 Pg.112).
